notes.content: TRANSFER SELECTION CRITERIA REQUIRED FOR ADMISSIONS

To be a competitive transfer applicant to the San Luis Obispo campus, review Cal Poly’s Selection Criteria for Transfer Students for your major of interest. This page outlines Cal Poly San Luis Obispo general requirements for required and desired courses for admission.
notes.contentHtml: To be a competitive transfer applicant to the San Luis Obispo campus, review Cal Poly’s Selection Criteria for Transfer Students for your major of interest. This page outlines Cal Poly San Luis Obispo general requirements for required and desired courses for admission.

notes.content: Thank you for your interest in Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo! This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in major and support. Students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer. Cal Poly San Luis Obispo campus has specific selection criteria for transfer students for admissions, and we encourage you to check the selection criteria for the major you are interested in. GENERAL INFORMATION University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements for San Luis Obispo campus Cal Poly website for information on our campus ACADEMIC INFORMATION Experience and Event Management requirements and flowchart can be viewed on the major page in the catalog, under the requirements tab. Information about concentrations, if applicable, are displayed on this page. AP/IB/CLEP credit Academic Advising Transfer Credits at Cal Poly Cal Poly converted from the quarter system to semesters for Fall 2026. Find out more information on Semester conversion website | Specific College semester conversion websites Cal Poly San Luis Obispo and Cal Poly Maritime Academy has integrated into one university with two locations. Cal Poly Maritime Academy will be known as Solano Campus. Each respective campus will maintain separate assist.org accounts until Fall 2028, when our curriculum is fully integrated. The Mathematics and Physics departments recommend completing these respective courses in person since the engagement inherent to in-person experiences best aligns with Cal Poly's Learn by Doing philosophy and in our experience best prepares students for upper-division coursework and the rigor of Cal Poly's curriculum. This is not a static document; new articulation may be added at any time. The information provided herein is subject to change without notice and does not constitute a contract or the terms and conditions of a contract between the student and the institution or the California State University.
notes.contentHtml:
Thank you for your interest in Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo!

This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in major and support. Students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer. Cal Poly San Luis Obispo campus has specific selection criteria for transfer students for admissions, and we encourage you to check the selection criteria for the major you are interested in. 

GENERAL INFORMATION

  • University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major
  • Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements for San Luis Obispo campus
  • Cal Poly website for information on our campus

ACADEMIC INFORMATION

  • Experience and Event Management requirements and flowchart can be viewed on the major page in the catalog, under the requirements tab. Information about concentrations, if applicable, are displayed on this page.
  • AP/IB/CLEP credit
  • Academic Advising  
  • Transfer Credits at Cal Poly
  • Cal Poly converted from the quarter system to semesters for Fall 2026. Find out more information on Semester conversion website | Specific College semester conversion websites 
  • Cal Poly San Luis Obispo and Cal Poly Maritime Academy has integrated into one university with two locations. Cal Poly Maritime Academy will be known as Solano Campus. Each respective campus will maintain separate assist.org accounts until Fall 2028, when our curriculum is fully integrated. 

The Mathematics and Physics departments recommend completing these respective courses in person since the engagement inherent to in-person experiences best aligns with Cal Poly's Learn by Doing philosophy and in our experience best prepares students for upper-division coursework and the rigor of Cal Poly's curriculum.

This is not a static document; new articulation may be added at any time. The information provided herein is subject to change without notice and does not constitute a contract or the terms and conditions of a contract between the student and the institution or the California State University.
